title: Burmese–Siamese War (1584–1593)
text: The Burmese–Siamese War (1584–1593), also known as the Nandric War, was a war fought between the Toungoo dynasty of Burma and the Ayutthaya Kingdom of Siam. This war led Ayutthaya out of Burmese vassalship. This war was notable for the duel between King Naresuan and the Burmese Crown-Prince, Mingyi Swa. This war freed Siam from further Burmese domination for 174 years until 1767 when King Hsinbyushin invaded Siam, which resulted in the fall of Ayutthaya.
